description:
Watch Low Cut Connie's Adam Weiner perform "Little Freakers"  in The Current studio

During a tour stop in the Twin Cities that saw him play a sold-out show at the Turf Club in St. Paul, Adam Weiner of Low Cut Connie visited The Current for a session hosted by Jill Riley.  Watch a performance of "Little Freakers" above.
